subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and should that currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a high-bar public config surface and changes how estimated model costs are represented across status output, session summaries, usage APIs, UI aggregation, docs, and USD-named telemetry fields.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting-versus-display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

options.title: Keep configured model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave local model pricing as USD estimates and rely on provider usage snapshots for provider-reported non-USD balances.

options.title: Add a display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow formatter override while explicitly leaving stored values and telemetry as USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting-versus-display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans cost UI, config semantics, docs, status output, and stored/API naming, matching this handle's recent cost/config history.
